import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
from datetime import datetime

# Connect to database
conn = sqlite3.connect('dacomp-019.sqlite')

# Read the supplementary batch data again
supplementary_data = pd.read_csv('pricing_system_supplementary_batch.csv')

# Create a copy with all pricing_system columns filled with NULLs
full_schema = pd.DataFrame(index=supplementary_data.index)

# Map the existing columns
column_map = {
    'Price ID': 'Price ID',
    'Drug ID': 'Drug ID',
    'Purchase Price (incl. tax)': 'Purchase Price (incl. tax)',
    'Retail Price (incl. tax)': 'Retail Price (incl. tax)',
    'Price Validity Period': 'Price Validity Period',
    'Price Filing Number': 'Price Filing Number'
}

# Fill the mapped columns
for src_col, dest_col in column_map.items():
    full_schema[dest_col] = supplementary_data[src_col]

# Fill remaining columns with NULL (will be handled by SQL as NULL)
remaining_columns = [col for col in pd.read_sql("PRAGMA table_info(pricing_system);", conn)['name'].tolist() 
                    if col not in column_map.values()]
for col in remaining_columns:
    full_schema[col] = None

# Convert to SQL parameters format
params = full_schema.replace({pd.NA: None}).replace({np.nan: None}).to_sql_params(index=False)

# Insert into pricing_system table
insert_query = "INSERT INTO pricing_system VALUES ({})".format(', '.join(['?'] * len(full_schema)))
cursor = conn.cursor()
cursor.executemany(insert_query, params)

# Get the row count
row_count = cursor.rowcount

# Record in data_ingestion_log
log_query = """
INSERT INTO data_ingestion_log (batch_id, source_file, loaded_at, row_count)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
"""
cursor.execute(log_query, (
    'pricing_system_supplementary_batch',
    'pricing_system_supplementary_batch.csv',
    datetime.now().isoformat(),
    row_count
))

# Commit and close
conn.commit()
